messages:
olivia: heads-up: ran into a customer case where a resumed stream + background prefetch both led to confirmed charges of the same prefix. repro attached.
tom: can you drop the minimal logs here?
olivia: sure:
```
2026-06-05T08:21:10.001Z [router] session=abc event=provisional_claim prefix=80 tx=tx-r
2026-06-05T08:21:10.006Z [prefetch] session=abc event=provisional_claim prefix=80 tx=tx-p
2026-06-05T08:21:10.015Z [ledger] tx=tx-r event=confirm tokens=80
2026-06-05T08:21:10.018Z [ledger] tx=tx-p event=confirm tokens=80
```
olivia: ledger totals both confirms, so customer sees +80 tokens twice.
kevin: classic race. prefetch issues provisional without verifying router claim. two distinct tx ids -> double confirm.
julia: UX: console should show per-session provisional tx ids and who created them (router vs prefetch). aggregated counts hide duplicates.
ops-bot: billing-alert created session=abc delta=+80
kevin: quick fixes:
- make prefetch check a session-level claimed_prefixes marker before provisional (fast local check)
- add a small handshake RPC from prefetch -> router to ask for claim; if router returns "already claimed" skip provisional
- ledger side: on confirm, detect overlapping provisional ranges for same session and collapse to canonical (router-preferred) within N ms window
infra: handshake RPC needs to be best-effort and non-blocking; can't add tail latency to resume. sidecars should do it async or with a tiny timeout.
julia: console patch: timeline view with provisional list (tx id, source, ts) and confirm events. add quick filter provisional-only or confirmed-only for billing ops.
kevin: ledger dedupe is messy but safest long-term. rule: when confirms overlap by prefix range for same session within 1s, treat them as a single canonical confirm and mark duplicates as reconciled credits.
ops-bot: created ticket billing/duplicate-prefix-reconciler
billing-bot: alert rule added: if confirmed_tokens - max(provisional_canonical) > threshold => page billing-oncall
olivia: immediate mitigation: ship sidecar guard that checks local session marker and tags provisional as "prefetch:tentative" so ledger can delay auto-confirm for tentative entries.
kevin: we'll pair on RFC: include reproducer, three mitigation options, console mockups, and ledger dedupe tradeoffs. propose canary in eu-west next week.
olivia: thanks. posting repro script in the RFC. ping me to pair on the canary run. :thumbsup:
